'''''Diphysa''''' is a genus of [[flowering plant]]s in the [[legume]] family, [[Fabaceae]]. It belongs to the subfamily [[Faboideae]], and was recently assigned to the informal [[monophyly|monophyletic]] ''Dalbergia'' clade of the [[Dalbergieae]].<ref name="Lavin" /><ref name="Cardoso"/> It includes 22 species which range from Arizona through Mexico and Central America to Colombia and Venezuela.<ref name = powo/>
